messages:
Amy: quick verify after the EU1 rollout — embedding route showing p99 jitter and a small 5xx uptick. p99 from 220ms -> 1.1s in last 2m, errors ~0.6% vs baseline 0.05%.
Amy: attaching synth log snippet: `synth-run --route=embeddings-eu1 --window=60s` returned intermittent 502/504.
deploy-bot: Release v2026.03.21-rc4 rolled to EU1 (25%) at 1767889940.
canary-bot: Probe summary (60s): p50 26ms, p95 160ms, p99 1050ms, error_rate 0.62%. Pattern: spikes correlate with burst batch size >16.
Jordan: is this happening for both model variants or one? perf-bot can we get per-variant p99?
perf-bot: Variant breakdown: quant3-eu1 p99 1450ms err 1.1%; float32-eu1 p99 120ms err 0.03%. Current traffic split on EU1: 60% quant3, 40% float32.
Amy: looks like quant3 on burst batches. we swapped quant3 in to improve tail latency for small requests but maybe memory/packing behaves badly on spikes.
sre-oncall: infra shows short spike of host-side CPU throttling and transient conn resets from gateway to inference pool during the window. No node-wide OOMs.
ops: we can quickly reroute traffic at the edge. recommend route-fallback to float32 for EU1 until root cause found.
Amy: +1. propose: 1) pause further increase, 2) pin EU1 to float32 only, 3) run targeted synth with controlled batch distribution (1..32) and concurrency sweep.
deploy-bot: Action: rollout paused at 25% (1767889975). Routing pinned to float32 for embeddings-eu1. Notifying release channel.
Jordan: please add a short line to release notes: "Hold: quant3 variant in EU1 paused due to p99 regression under burst batches during postdeploy probes."
Amy: done: posted to #release-notes and linked INF-2410 (repro and logs).
perf-bot: repro command used by CI harness: 
```
./ci/synth_runner --route embeddings-eu1 --variants quant3,float32 --batch-dist "[1:0.5,4:0.2,16:0.2,32:0.1]" --duration 120
```
Amy: Anita / Jordan can you run local mem-profiling when you reproduce? add `--trace-mem` flag.
Jordan: will run matrix today. ETA 3h. I'll try increasing model-worker soft limits and a controlled restart to see behavior.
sre-oncall: I'll reduce probe burstiness on the watchlist and set a temporary circuit-breaker threshold so user traffic isn't affected by synth spikes.
ops: also enabling a short-term autoscaler headroom of +2 nodes for EU1 until we confirm stable.
Amy: decision recap: hold rollout at 25%, pin EU1 embeddings to float32, create INF-2410 for reproducer and tracing, adjust autoscaler & circuit-breaker protections. No full release rollback yet.
Jordan: noted. will update INF-2410 with profiling gist and steps.
Amy: thanks everyone. will reopen thread with reproducer results. :white_check_mark:
